title: Best Practices for Managing API Costs
excerpt: Practical tips to keep your API spending predictable and under control.

content.p: In the token settings you can configure a maximum quota per token, so a runaway integration can never drain your balance.
If your app makes the same request often, cache the answer. This can cut costs dramatically.
Combine multiple small tasks into a single request with a structured output instead of calling the API many times.
Check the log page to see which tokens and models consume the most credits, then optimize those paths first.

faq.q: What is the safest cost setting?
faq.a: A hard quota per token. It caps spend even if an integration misbehaves.

faq.q: How often should I check the logs?
faq.a: At least weekly, or daily if your app is high-traffic.

faq.q: Do failed requests still cost credits?
faq.a: Yes, if tokens were consumed before the failure. Retries can add up, so watch them.
Usage-based alerts are on the roadmap and will arrive later this year.
